name: Sabanalarga (Atlántico, Colombia)
description: Yellow lower half, the upper half divided vertically green and white.
history: Municipal flag of Sabanalarga, a municipality in the department of Atlántico, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: upper half green and white, lower half yellow
